I stopped at the skill's first step. This project has no `_codev/` folder: `codev status --json` returned `no_codev_root`, and the root holds only `README.md`, `index.js`, `package.json` and `.claude/`.

The skill won't create `_codev/config.yaml` itself, so I didn't get as far as reading the project, drafting a proposal or asking the confirmation question. Nothing was written.

Run `codev init` first, then come back to `/codev-configure`.

Separately, the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings before they can be used. This task didn't need them.
